meta.purpose: Display-only centers for schematic equal-area circles. These coordinates are not legal concession centroids or boundaries.
meta.geometryMeaning: PERKIRAAN LUAS IZIN — bukan batas legal konsesi
caveats: Circle area is derived from the reported permit area, but circle shape is schematic.
Center precision varies by holding and is explicitly labeled.
Do not use these centers for legal boundary analysis, FIRMS attribution, or point-in-concession claims.

jarr-hgu.label: Batu Ampar / Simpang Empat, Tanah Bumbu
jarr-hgu.evidence: JARR official profile confirms Batu Ampar as the operational locality; a published company-profile map provides this coordinate as a plant/location reference.

pgun-hgu.label: Batu Engau, Paser
pgun-hgu.evidence: PGUN places its operations in Batu Engau; the display center uses the published administrative coordinate for Batu Engau rather than a concession centroid.

jam-pbph.label: PT Jhonlin Agro Mandiri reference point
jam-pbph.evidence: AidEnvironment published a satellite figure of the Jhonlin Agro Mandiri concession with this coordinate label. It is used only as a display reference point.

inni-joa-pbph.label: Tanah Bumbu
inni-joa-pbph.evidence: Government planning material places PT Inni Joa in Tanah Bumbu. The display center is the midpoint of Tanah Bumbu's published geographic bounds, not the PBPH centroid.

kodeco-timber-pbph.label: Kotabaru / Tanah Bumbu
kodeco-timber-pbph.evidence: KLHK basis data places PT Kodeco Timber across Kotabaru and Tanah Bumbu. This display center is intentionally coarse and is not a concession centroid.

taiyoung-engreen-pbph.label: Gunung Mas, Kalimantan Tengah
taiyoung-engreen-pbph.evidence: The display center is the midpoint of the published geographic bounds for PT Taiyoung Engreen.
